entries.zh: 淫妇；失德之妇（妇人有失妇德、不守贞节）
entries.en: adulterous woman; a woman who has lost her (marital) virtue

entries.zh: 妇人改嫁、另适他人（“换过脚”为再嫁的讳称；教士语境视再嫁同失贞）
entries.en: an adulterous woman; a woman who remarries or changes husbands (lit. 'change feet')

entries.zh: 妇人改嫁、其身易主（“换过手”谓妇人已属他人；义同上条）
entries.en: an adulterous woman; a woman passed into another man's hand, remarried

entries.zh: 温润、柔和（性情平和而不刚硬）
entries.en: mild and smooth; soft, gentle (of disposition)
entries.notes: 官话栏 inên 与第13条“软”注音同形，疑为“润”注音之转写歧异；释义据西、汉、闽南三栏互证，义无可疑。

entries.en: mild, affable; of good temper, well-disposed

entries.zh: 温润（温和而柔润，谓人有涵养）
entries.en: gentle and refined; affable and modest
gentle and respectful; affable and humble
warm-hearted and generous; of good natural disposition

entries.zh: 柔软（质软不硬，亦指性情柔和）
柔弱（软弱不强健；性柔无力）
情（内心情感、情意；即心之所倾向）
entries.en: inner feeling, affection; inclination of the heart
deeply affectionate; earnest and sincere in feeling

entries.zh: 性情（天生的情感气质；喜怒爱恶之情）
衷（内心、衷情；出于天性的内心倾向）
entries.en: the inner heart, sincere feeling; natural inclination
